steps.title: Initialize Project Structure
steps.description: Create the basic HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript files for the new digital clock application.

steps.title: Configure Tailwind CSS
steps.description: Add the Tailwind CSS CDN to index.html for utility-first styling.

steps.title: Design Clock Layout Container
steps.description: Create a central container in HTML for the digital clock, using Flexbox for centering.

steps.title: Implement Time Display Elements
steps.description: Add HTML elements (divs or spans) to display hours, minutes, and seconds.

steps.title: Implement Date Display Element
steps.description: Add an HTML element to display the current date.

steps.title: Initialize JavaScript References
steps.description: Get references to the time and date display elements in script.js.

steps.title: Create `updateClock` Function
steps.description: Develop a JavaScript function to fetch the current time and date.

steps.title: Implement Time Formatting Logic
steps.description: Add logic within `updateClock` to format hours, minutes, and seconds with leading zeros.

steps.title: Implement Date Formatting Logic
steps.description: Add logic within `updateClock` to format the current day, month, and year.

steps.title: Update UI with Formatted Time and Date
steps.description: Set the `textContent` of the HTML elements with the formatted time and date.

steps.title: Set Up Real-time Update Interval
steps.description: Use `setInterval` to call `updateClock` every second for real-time display.

steps.title: Apply Tailwind CSS Styling for Visuals
steps.description: Add Tailwind CSS classes to enhance the visual appearance of the clock and its elements, ensuring readability.

steps.title: Ensure Responsiveness
steps.description: Verify the clock layout adapts gracefully to different screen sizes using Tailwind's responsive utilities.

steps.title: Building digitalclock
steps.description: The Digital Clock web application is now complete and ready for use.
